p99_9.valid_when: the members at the high-stress voxels have an estimated 3.5 voxels or more through them (the report checks this with `member_thickness`), and a hole or fillet has at least 4 voxels across its diameter (the report does not check this). It is the condition of the bench and not a guarantee: on public parts 6 of the 18 cells that met the member gate had an error outside the bench band (-54 % to +13 %, bench/stress_accuracy.json; cells in bench/stress_public_parts.json)

data_base.note: bench shapes: beam, plate with a hole, and the hook against B2 (the only real part of the bench); public parts: bracket, hook, ladle, phone_stand, shelf_bracket (a cell is a part, a load case and a run type); the hook is in both sets, with other runs (bench 1.2 mm, public 2.4 mm)

p99_9.reason: no verdict for now (no verdict without data). The band of the error of the voxel p99.9 (voxel value / reference - 1) is -59 % to +57 % of the reference, the union of the bench and the public parts: lower end -59 % (measured -58.32 %) from the 5 public parts: hook, pull_off, run type MS, voxel 2.4 mm; upper end +57 % (measured +56.91 %) from the 5 public parts: phone_stand, poke, run type MS, voxel 2.45 mm; data: bench/stress_public_parts.json. Each end is set by one row or cell, with no margin. The bench alone gave -54 % to +13 % (lower end, measured -53.32 %: the hook, pull_off, voxel 1.2 mm, against P2; upper end, measured +12.95 %: plate with a hole, 8 voxels across the hole, gross scaling of the reference; data: bench/stress_accuracy.json). The member gate does not predict the error: the hook at 1.2 mm passes it (p10 3.84 voxels) and has -53 %, while the beam at 4 voxels has -28 %. The data base is 11 rows of the bench (3 shapes, 1 real part) and 51 cells of 5 public parts; 4 of the 11 rows and 31 of the 51 cells have fewer than 5000 voxels, so their p99.9 is the peak. The band is the largest error measured, not a bound for other parts: on 5 public parts (51 cells) the error of the voxel p99.9 against the P2 p99.9 of `topopt verify` (voxel / P2 - 1) was -58 % (hook, pull_off, run type MS, voxel 2.4 mm) to +57 % (phone_stand, poke, run type MS, voxel 2.45 mm), in both directions: the voxel value was above P2 in 23 cells, mostly grey mass-objective designs, and up to 2.4 times below P2 on a coarse part with thin members; 15 of the 51 cells were outside the bench band (-54 % to +13 %, bench/stress_accuracy.json), and the member gate did not keep the error inside the bench band (6 of the 18 cells that met it were above +13 %); source bench/stress_public_parts.json. For the stress of the part, run `topopt verify`

peak.valid_when: the members at the high-stress voxels have an estimated 3.5 voxels or more through them (the report checks this with `member_thickness`), and a hole or fillet has at least 4 voxels across its diameter (the report does not check this). It is the condition of the bench and not a guarantee: on public parts 3 of the 18 cells that met the member gate had a voxel peak more than 72 % below the P2 peak (72 % is the lower end of the bench band, bench/stress_accuracy.json; cells in bench/stress_public_parts.json)

data_base.note: bench shapes: beam, plate with a hole, and the hook against B2 (the only real part of the bench); public parts: bracket, hook, ladle, phone_stand, shelf_bracket (a cell is a part, a load case and a run type); the hook is in both sets, with other runs (bench 1.2 mm, public 2.4 mm)

peak.reason: the voxel peak is below the reference in every measured case (the centre of a voxel lies half a voxel below the surface), the sign is not known for other shapes, and the peak of a corner or load point depends on the voxel size. The band of the error (voxel value / reference - 1) is -88 % to 0 % of the reference: lower end -88 % (measured -87.14 %) from the 5 public parts: ladle, full_scoop, run type MF, voxel 3.25 mm, variant S2; upper end 0 % (measured -4.82 %) from the bench: beam, 16 voxels through the thickness; data: bench/stress_accuracy.json, bench/stress_public_parts.json. The reference of the public cells is the P2 peak at the quadrature points; the P2 peak depends on the mesh of `topopt verify` (`limits` in bench/stress_public_parts.json). For the stress of the part, run `topopt verify`

verdict_rule.error_definition: error = voxel value / reference - 1. The reference lies between value / (1 + over) and value / (1 - under)
